results.title: Trump launches new effort to oust Fed Governor Lisa Cook | CNN Business
results.content:
Trump has long berated the politically independent Fed because it hasn’t lowered interest rates to his liking, publicly targeting Cook and former Fed Chair Jerome Powell. But Trump has spared the current chairman, Kevin Warsh, whom he appointed to the position earlier this year after Powell’s term at the head of the central bank expired. Instead, Trump has insisted that Warsh is blocked by a “political” Board of Governors. [...] The central bank’s eight-member Board votes on interest rate decisions, along with regional Fed presidents. While the Fed leader often plays an influential role in shaping the discussion on policy moves, decisions are ultimately the result of the 12-person committee process.

At its September meeting, all 12 members, including Warsh, voted to raise rates for the first time in three years in an effort to contain inflation that has heated up largely due to the US war with Iran. [...] The formation of the committee marks the latest salvo in Trump’s ongoing attempts to reshape the Fed and comes just weeks ahead of its next monetary policy meeting, where officials will consider whether interest rate changes are merited.

# Fed’s Warsh Earns IMF Praise for Focusing on Price Stability

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh got a thumbs-up from the head of the International Monetary Fund for taking the pursuit of price stability seriously. [...] “I want to praise him,” IMF’s Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said Wednesday in an interview with Bloomberg Television’s Haslinda Amin. “He sent a clear signal that price stability is a priority for the Fed and that the Fed would pursue it, not only with words but also with actions.”
